question: Which sea, located in the north-western part of the Indian Ocean, joins the Gulf of Oman in the north-west and the Gulf of Aden in the south-west and covers a total area of 1,491,000 square miles?
solution: The correct answer is the __**Arabian Sea**__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Arabian Sea** is **located in the northwestern of the Indian Ocean.** • It's in the **north-western Indian Ocean** and **connects the Gulf of Oman to the north-west and the Gulf of Aden **to the south-west. • The Arabian Sea **encompasses a total area of about 1,491,000** square miles. • The** Arabian Sea has a rich history of maritime trade,** dating back to the 3rd or 2nd millennium BCE. •
